ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Acme Semiconductor Inc. is a fictional company created solely for testing this parser. We design and sell graphics and accelerated computing platforms to hyperscale data center customers worldwide.

Our reportable segments are Data Center, Gaming, and Professional Visualization, which together represent substantially all of our revenue in the periods presented.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our business depends on a small number of large customers. The loss of any one of these customers could materially and adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.

We rely on third-party foundries to manufacture our products, and supply constraints have in the past limited our ability to meet customer demand.
